safe_content_feature_requests.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt System
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Helps first-time players understand initial movement and combat mechanics without confusion.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: First-time players need clear introductory prompts at step 0 to grasp how traversal and combat interact.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add introductory guidance pop-ups or text tooltips for new players starting their first route.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Route-Specific Secret Collectibles and Cosmetic Unlocks
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Gives players strong reasons to revisit previously completed routes to hunt down rare drops.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Revisiting routes currently lacks specialized discovery mechanics once standard completion rewards are claimed.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Introduce rare hidden pick-ups on existing routes that unlock themed accessories or vanity tints.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Adjusted Marketplace Bundle Special for Mid-Tier Cosmetics
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Helps bridge the currency gap for players saving toward elite crown items by offering a temporary thematic bundle discount.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: The coin delta between standard route completion rewards and high-end items like the Waypoint Crown leaves players stranded with low balances (21 coins remaining in trace), making a promotional discount or milestone coin bonus very effective for retention.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Introduce a rotating weekend marketplace special or bundle discount to maintain purchasing momentum for active economy players.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Keyboard Shortcut Prompts on Marketplace & HUD
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Allows keyboard-only users to navigate menus instantly without needing to switch to a mouse.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Clear hotkey indicators reduce cognitive load and improve usability for accessibility-focused players.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add visible keyboard shortcut hints (e.g., [1] to buy, [Esc] to close) directly onto UI buttons and marketplace panels.

all_feature_requests.title: Movement Command Input Buffering & Obstacle Feedback
all_feature_requests.player_value: Prevents accidental repetitive self-damage when players press directional walk keys against static obstacles.
all_feature_requests.rationale: Edge-case telemetry shows players frequently attempt to keep walking into barriers before realizing a jump is required.
all_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add input validation so that walking into an active hazard triggers an immediate contextual hint or buffers the necessary jump command.

observations.evidence: Telemetry shows the session starting directly on the Moss Trail with walk actions and combat encounters, but there are no welcome tooltips or tutorial prompts at step 0 for a first-time player.
observations.recommendation: Implement welcome tooltips and introductory guidance for initial movement and combat mechanics.

observations.evidence: Completing Moss Trail rewarded 25 coins, bringing total currency to 149, with zero cosmetics owned.
observations.recommendation: Ensure first-time players receive a clear introductory milestone reward or overview of how coins are used in the marketplace.

observations.evidence: Completed Gloomwood Hollow and received standard completion coins, but found no visible tracking or ledger for unique collectibles like Gloomcap or Root Relic.
observations.recommendation: Implement the planned Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI to give collectors a satisfying way to track their discovered items across routes.

observations.evidence: Successfully purchased and equipped the 'trail_cap' cosmetic after finishing Gloomwood Hollow, ending with 88 coins.
observations.recommendation: Keep expanding the cosmetic catalog with hats and trails tied to specific route completion achievements.

observations.evidence: Route completion rewards are functional (+25 coins), but there are limited specific incentives or hidden secrets driving repeated revisits to already-completed routes.
observations.recommendation: Add route mastery levels, secret collectible variants, or time-trial goals to encourage players to replay routes.

observations.evidence: In a 12-step high-difficulty route (Frostfang Pass, Difficulty 3), only two enemy encounters occurred (Slime at step 2, Kobold at step 11), with long stretches of uninterrupted movement and jumping.
observations.recommendation: Increase enemy spawn frequency and introduce mixed enemy group formations on Difficulty 3+ routes to maintain combat pacing and engagement.

observations.evidence: Encountered standard basic enemies (Slime, Kobold) on Frostfang Pass with no special abilities, hazards synergy, or tactical telegraphing observed in the trace.
observations.recommendation: Add elite behavior profiles or phase changes to enemies on high-difficulty paths to reward player mastery and precision.

observations.evidence: Completing the Treasure Run yielded 25 coins plus 5 found on the route, totaling 30 coins earned, but marketplace cosmetics cost 45, 80, and more, leaving the player with only 21 coins after two purchases and unable to buy a premium item like the Waypoint Crown.
observations.recommendation: Monitor coin pacing across difficulty level 2 routes to ensure single-run completions feel closer to mid-tier cosmetic affordability without devaluing long-term progression goals.

observations.evidence: Current backlog item 'High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus States' mentions marketplace navigation and UI elements needing clearer keyboard focus rings.
observations.recommendation: Implement high-contrast focus rings and clear visual state indicators for all interactive buttons during keyboard and mouse navigation.

observations.evidence: Marketplace purchase flow successfully executed, providing clear text confirmation ('Purchased and equipped Trail Cap for 45 coins.') and remaining coin balance.
observations.recommendation: Maintain this clear post-purchase feedback pattern across all marketplace items and cosmetic unlocks.

observations.evidence: Telemetry shows two consecutive 'obstacle_hit' events (damage: 8) at step 2 when walking into an obstacle before the player input successfully switched to 'jump'.
observations.recommendation: Implement input buffering or automatic command validation to prevent redundant movement commands from queuing against active hazard collisions.

observations.evidence: Route completion successfully triggered and awarded 25 coins upon reaching step 13 on Ember Forge.
observations.recommendation: Maintain current route completion state transition logic as it resolves cleanly.

bugs.title: Redundant Walk Commands Queue Against Active Obstacle Collisions
repro_steps: Walk forward until reaching an obstacle at step 2.
Issue repeated 'walk' commands while blocked by the obstacle.
bugs.expected: The game should either ignore invalid movement commands or automatically prompt/buffer a jump without repeatedly penalizing the player with damage ticks.
bugs.observed: Multiple walk attempts registered against the obstacle, resulting in two successive obstacle hit events and taking 16 total damage before jumping.
